description: Send a draft you prepared, by its id. Call this when a staged draft is ready to go out. If the mailbox requires human approval, this returns 202 {draft_id, status:"pending_approval"} — the draft is queued for a human to approve, which is NOT a failure and must NOT be retried; it is sent once approved. Otherwise it sends immediately and returns the message id.

id.description: Id of the draft to send, from create_draft or list_drafts.

name: send_draft
